title: Fig. 2 analogue — Team size, disruption and citation counts
description: Design-weighted mean within-publication-year D percentile (A) and median unique strictly postpublication citing works through 23 November 2026 (B) for 7,997 works with defined D. Stratum n is below each team size; dotted separator marks grouped sizes. Error bars: pointwise 95% stratified design replicate intervals; ranks recalculated. The 51–100 stratum is a census, so its citation median is fixed, but its ranks can vary with other strata.

reviews.summary: The figure supports the overall C1 pattern through the 51–100-author stratum. Both outcomes, stratum sample sizes, and pointwise 95% design-based intervals are easy to read. The caption explains why the largest stratum's citation median has no visible interval while its disruption rank still does.

issues.problem: C1 could be read as claiming a monotonic change or a separate estimate for exactly 100 authors. Both series show local reversals or plateaus, and the largest teams are pooled in the 51–100-author stratum.
issues.fix: Describe the finding as an overall association across team-size strata: mean disruption percentile generally falls and median citations generally rise, with the pattern extending to the pooled 51–100-author group.

issues.problem: The caption explains the vertical separator but not the horizontal dashed line in panel A.
issues.fix: Identify the horizontal dashed line as the 50th-percentile reference.
